package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// AutoReviewRepoPG implements auto review storage.
type AutoReviewRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Save inserts or updates auto review.
func (r AutoReviewRepoPG) Save(ctx context.Context, review domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview) error {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(review.RawResult)
	_, err := r.Pool.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO student_task_answer_auto_review (id, student_task_answer_id, checked_at, validator_name, auto_score, passed, feedback, raw_result)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8)
ON CONFLICT (student_task_answer_id) DO UPDATE SET checked_at=EXCLUDED.checked_at, validator_name=EXCLUDED.validator_name, auto_score=EXCLUDED.auto_score, passed=EXCLUDED.passed, feedback=EXCLUDED.feedback, raw_result=EXCLUDED.raw_result`,
		review.ID, review.StudentTaskAnswerID, review.CheckedAt, review.ValidatorName, review.AutoScore, review.Passed, review.Feedback, raw)
	return err
}

// GetByAnswerID returns review for answer.
func (r AutoReviewRepoPG) GetByAnswerID(ctx context.Context, answerID string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview, error) {
	row := r.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, student_task_answer_id, checked_at, validator_name, auto_score, passed, feedback, raw_result FROM student_task_answer_auto_review WHERE student_task_answer_id=$1`, answerID)
	var review domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview
	var raw json.RawMessage
	if err := row.Scan(&review.ID, &review.StudentTaskAnswerID, &review.CheckedAt, &review.ValidatorName, &review.AutoScore, &review.Passed, &review.Feedback, &raw); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(raw) > 0 {
		_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &review.RawResult)
	}
	return &review, nil
}

var _ repository.AutoReviewRepository = (*AutoReviewRepoPG)(nil)
